milestones.title: The owner decides on an independent sovereignty review once the lab site's rows reach Met

remediation: Every credible sovereignty label is issued by an assessor at a stated assurance level (CAN/DGSI 100-8 and its SovereignReady programme; the EU framework's assurance levels). The sovereignty card is a self-check from evidence and says so. When the lab site's rows reach Met, the owner decides whether to seek an independent review (48.4-04), and the card's scope line then names that assessment and its level. Sovereignty: assessments.
title: No independent sovereignty assessment exists; the sovereignty card is a self-check from evidence
